notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: Follow-up from op-u6s.8 (collision now on GPU, but NO crossover vs 12-core CpuMultiThread on RTX 3050: ~1.9x slower at 1e6, gap narrowing with batch size). To actually beat multi-thread: (1) sort/compact live neutrons by reaction to cut warp divergence; (2) bank fission daughters on the GPU too (remove the per-generation CPU pass); (3) overlap event dispatches / persistent-thread kernel to shorten the sequential per-event dispatch chain; (4) test on larger batches / stronger GPU / fewer-core CPU where the measured trend predicts crossover. See crates/outram-mc-libs/docs/gpu_collision_dev_log.md for the before/after tables.

title: outram-mc: push GPU event transport past CpuMultiThread (sort-by-reaction, fused daughter banking, larger batches)
